//: CareGrid AI — Firestore composite indexes. Phase 2 requires NONE of them; the `users` and `profiles` queries are single-field, which Firestore indexes automatically. The list below is docs/07 §11.2 verbatim, added when Phase 3 creates the incident database. Kept now so the collection is decided before the queries are, not after.
//index_rule: docs/07 §11.2 note: array-membership fields (array-contains, in) must come BEFORE range/equality fields. Index 6 is therefore geoCells (array-contains) > status (in) > updatedAt (desc).

indexes.//: Index 1 — the dispatcher queue default: active incidents, freshest first.
Index 2 — a citizen's own reports, newest first.
Index 3 — the admin archive: soft-deleted incidents, newest first.
Index 4 — responder availability, for the candidate list.
Index 5 — admin user list, filtered by role and newest first.
Index 6 — THE GEOSPATIAL ONE. array-contains first, per the field-order rule above.
Index 7 — cross-incident status history for the admin view.
Index 8 — a responder's own dispatches, newest first.
Index 9 — the notification bell: own unread, newest first.
Index 10 — the audit log: filtered by action, newest first.
